text: Anndee misal aduna nguurndam aduna ɗam ɗam dakmitorton ko lannata heña, ko wano toɓo jillondiroowo e puɗi leydi ndin, gabbe e dimɗe e huɗo ko yimɓe e neemoraaɗi ñaamata. Haa si leydi ndin ƴettii mbaadi mun njalɓundi ndin, ndi labinorii ko ndi fuɗini kon e nooji puɗi, yimɓe mayri ndin jikka wonnde ko ɓe hattamɓe soñugol tetta ko ndi fuɗini kon, ñaawoore Amen halko ɗum ara e mayri, Men waɗtina ndi soñiraandi wa si tawnii ndi ɗuuɗiraani leɗɗe e puɗi ado mun. Ko wano no Men ɓannginirani on fiyaaku aduna on e yaawugol lannugol makko, Men ɓannginirta ɓanngannduyeeji e hujjaaji ɓen miijitooɓe taskoo.
